# Tommy John Schiavoni (D): NYS Assembly, District 1

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Tommy John Schiavoni's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://www.tommyjohnschiavoni.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Incumbent. Opponent: [Stephen Kiely](../kiely-stephen/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/schiavoni-tommy-john> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A light incumbent page made up mostly of endorsement excerpts. The basic facts check out. Its record claims come from editorials and carry no bill numbers or amounts.

1. First Assembly term from January 2025 is confirmed; he succeeded Fred Thiele.
2. Funding and legislation claims are quoted from endorsing papers, not documented.
